title: microgrid-ems-v2: Reproduction code and data for "Within-Day Commitment Timing, Not Renewable Anticipation, Explains the Value of Forecast-Driven Dispatch in Solar-Battery-Diesel Mini-Grids"
description: Reproduction code and generated results for a rolling mixed-integer (MILP) energy management study of an islanded 90 kWp / 130 kWh / 40 kW solar-battery-diesel mini-grid in the Northern Region of Ghana. XGBoost load and PV forecasts, commitment-aware generator model, expanding-window walk-forward evaluation over 2022-2025. Weather: NASA POWER hourly reanalysis, 2018-2025. Demand: synthetic load_v2 profile (no metered site data; a stated limitation). Code: MIT. Generated data and results: CC BY 4.0.
